title: The Treatise of the Crimson Pair
summary: A treatise on deep red fire held in both hands as a matched pair that opens a guard from two sides and bursts between them.

title: The Hawk-Fire Canon of Descent
summary: A canon of fire that climbs on rising heat and stoops on its mark from above in the manner of a hawk.

title: The River of Fire Compendium
summary: A compendium of fire that flows along the ground like a current and divides and gathers and floods wide.

title: The Dual-Court Pyre Codex
summary: A codex of pyres raised in matched pairs whose joined heat finishes what a single fire would only wound.

title: The Twin-Track Inferno Treatise
summary: A treatise on running great fire down two tracks of the body and the field at once so each track hands off to the other.

title: The Sealed Fire of the Monarchs
summary: A rare manual of heat sealed inside the body and kept for one moment of release; held only by those who have reached the Monarch stage.

title: The Wind-Sworn Pyre Canon
summary: A canon of pyres fed by the wind and the breath and bound by a vow that the flame will not go out before the stroke lands.

title: The Oath of the Burning Bearing
summary: A sworn manual of fire loosed along a single fixed bearing that is held without a waver until the mark is burned through.

title: The Unwalled Fire Compendium
summary: A compendium of fire fought openly with no cover for the user and none for the foe; heat that hides nothing.

title: The Open Hand of Flame
summary: A manual of the open palm that gives heat to allies and takes the heat of a foe and sends it back.

title: A Treatise of the Long Reaching Fire
summary: A treatise on stretching flame across great distances so that a sworn archer of heat can burn a mark he cannot touch.

title: The Oath-Fire Manual of the Monarchs
summary: A rare manual in which a vow is made into heat that binds allies together and brands those who would turn on them.
